title: Large, quiet effective unit
text: Large, quiet effective unit. Let me start by saying that unlike the first reviewer, my unit was shipped in the manufacturer original packaging (not double boxed). This is a large and heavy unit and the bottom of the package actually was damaged and I was afraid the unit would also be damaged. Luckily, when the unit was removed from the box, I found the dehumidifier itself was not damaged. I thought this was a terrible way to send this item and Amazon was lucky that the unit was packaged well by the manufacturer. Now to the device itself... Like I mentioned, this is a very heavy device and I needed help getting it set up out of the box (warning to people who are not that strong). Once set up, the unit was surprisingly quiet and I also was surprised how much water the system collected from my basement (guess I never thought of my basement as that humid). The 70 pint container filled in just about 2 days and, again, I would warn anyone without much strength to empty it more frequently. Bottom line, great device, works as designed and super quiet, just heavy and poorly packaged for shipping. I would not buy this as a gift for anyone (as there is no privacy in the shipping).

product_metadata.title: Hisense DH-70K1SJE4 Energy Star 70-Pint 2-Speed Dehumidifier with Ionizer
features: Soft-touch electronic controls allows you easily to control the humidity level in your home
Digital display shows relative humidity, temperature and time
Auto restart restores unit to last setting used when power was disrupted
Washable air filter with a "clean filter" indicator light
Caster wheels make moving this unit a breeze
description: The Hisense DH-70K1SJE4 Energy Star 70-Pint 2-Speed Dehumidifier with Ionizer is an affordable and eco-friendly dehumidifier for large-sized spaces and operates at temperatures as low as 38 degrees F. This Energy Star-qualified model removes 70 pints of damaging moisture per day from spaces up to 1500 square feet. A fresh air ionizer and three operating modes (normal, continuous and auto dry) make it a versatile choice. Additional features include a programmable timer, adjustable humidistat, and full-tank alert. During the dehumidification process, water accumulates in the tank or is automatically emptied into a drain using a drainage hose such as a standard garden hose (drainage hose not included).
